rules: All eight layers use this exact 1024 x 1536 transparent canvas; never crop to pixels, re-centre, or scale an individual layer.

The clothes layer is a bound body-pose-and-outfit layer: it owns the half-body silhouette, sleeves, exposed hands and all posture. It contains no head or hair and is never mixed independently from a body pose.

The face layer owns the complete head skin, ears and a neck deliberately extended under the collar. The clothes layer is drawn later and must cover the lower neck. Eye includes brows. Hair is only split into hair_back and hair_front.
The head must be front-facing and centered. Clothes may have a restrained sleeve or hem gesture, but cannot rotate the torso enough to break head replacement.
